subject: Mutual Action Plan — initial draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medicahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Mutual Action Plan (initial draft + 2 timeline options)

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Based on what we discussed (performance targets, PII handling, and your integration constraints), I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) with two viable timeline options so you can pick the cadence that best fits internal availability. High level:

- Scope: Production inference for anonymized claims text, pilot with 1 model variant, observability hooks, and cost cap alerts.
- Risks noted: procurement window, security questionnaire turnaround, and a short dev slot for the integration team.

Two timeline options in the attached workbook:

Option A — Accelerated pilot (6 weeks)
- Kickoff: week of Jul 21
- Delivery: pilot ready by Aug 31
- Target close (commit/PO): Aug 22

Option B — Phased rollout (recommended if procurement/approval lags)
- Kickoff: week of Aug 4
- Pilot + integration: 8–10 weeks
- Target close (commit/PO): Sep 30

Ask: could you confirm the internal stakeholders who should appear on the MAP (owners, approvers, procurement contact) and tell us whether Option A or Option B looks more realistic given your procurement calendar? Also flag any dependencies we missed.

Attachments: MAP-initial-draft-20250712.xlsx (tabbed: milestones, owners, dependencies); I left placeholders for task owners so we can lock them down once you confirm stakeholders.

If it helps, I can send out a 30-min follow-up to walk the MAP with the working group — propose Tue/Wed next week.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

--
This message and attachments are intended only for the recipient(s) named above.
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medicahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Mutual Action Plan (initial draft + 2 timeline options)

Alex —

Thanks for the clear recap and for putting the draft together — very helpful. Quick answers from our side:

Stakeholders to include on the MAP (owners / approvers):
- Erin Walsh — Product Lead (owner)
- Samir Khan — Director of Engineering (integration owner)
- Jia Liu — Head of Security (security approver)
- Ben Hollis — Procurement (PO approver) — I will intro him if needed.

Procurement note: our finance/procurement window is tight mid-Aug to mid-Sep as we close our quarter-end approvals. I attached our procurement window doc; given that, Option B (phased rollout, target close Sep 30) is more realistic unless we get an expedited exception.

Also — Jia (security) will want to review data handling notes and the SOC2 artifact path. Can you cc your security contact or provide a short checklist so Jia can triage quickly?

I can make time for a 30-min working session next week. Tue afternoon or Wed morning PST works for Samir and me.

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
Product Lead, Medica Health
erin.walsh@medicahealth.com | (212) 555-0199

Thanks, Erin — really helpful context. Per your notes I updated the MAP (attached new file: MAP-updated-20250713.xlsx) to:

- Add Samir Khan (integration owner) and Jia Liu (security approver) as named stakeholders.
- Move target close to Sep 30 (Option B) and added a procurement milestone in mid-Aug to trigger your procurement team.
- Added a security checklist tab with the SOC2 artifact locations we discussed and an ask-box for Jia to confirm any gaps.

Next steps I propose:
1) We lock stakeholders in the updated MAP (please confirm any email addresses I should use for Ben Hollis / procurement).
2) Quick 30-min working session to walk the MAP and assign owners — Tue 22 Jul 14:00–14:30 PT / Wed 23 Jul 09:00–09:30 PT (please confirm which works).
3) Once stakeholders sign off, I’ll route the MAP to Legal for a light review and to Procurement for PO timing — I’ve added Marissa (solutions engineer) to help document integration tasks and Vivek (my manager) to support escalation if procurement needs priority handling.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-7890
Drive link to updated MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-map-link

CC: Marissa / Vivek — appreciate your availability for the working session and if one of you wants to take the integration-owner coordination with Samir, let me know.

Best,
Alex Martinez
